definitions.ask: Should the NEW section list every NEW reference, dropping today's 5-row cap?
definitions.why: One rule (dot = NEW = top section) is the clearer definition asked for; ⌥N keeps it short

choices.label: Dot and section always agree; on busy days Today can start below the fold
Today stays higher, but NEW rows past the fifth keep their dot down in Ready or Next

definitions.ask: How long should an unopened, unmarked reference stay NEW on its own?
definitions.why: Keeps the uncapped section short; ⌥N can hold any older reference in NEW

choices.label: 3 local days, today's Just added window; about 5-11 rows on recent days
7 local days; roughly twice as many rows, mostly agent reports

definitions.ask: Should a successful Link to Today (⌘N) in Bob Refs leave the reference NEW?
definitions.why: NEW keeps exactly three exits (open, ⌥N, leaving Ready/Next); the Today pill shows the link

choices.label: It stays NEW, in the NEW section with its pink Today pill, until opened or ⌥N
Linking also marks it seen, so it shows under Today after the next re-rank

definitions.ask: Should the plan add a decisions-web record for the Refs NEW state?
